note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week.
headline: The Saudi-Houthi fighting widened: a drone at Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oilfield (Oct 20, 2 killed by debris) and an attack on Dammam airport (Oct 21, 1 killed, 8 injured) (#1345, #1346). The Houthis claim more attacks on Riyadh, Dammam, Najran, Khamis Mushait, pipelines and Aden (Oct 24, #1348).

The US is pulling people back, not joining: State ordered non-emergency staff and families out of Saudi Arabia on Oct 21 (#1347), after an unprecedented wave of embassy security alerts across 9 countries on Oct 18-19 (#1344).

Still no US strike on the Houthis since the May 6, 2025 ceasefire (#1319). ABC (Oct 20) says the administration is wary of opening a second front while the Iran conflict is unsettled; US help to Saudi Arabia stays at intelligence and targeting (#1335).
No Houthi attack on US forces or on non-Saudi shipping was found this week. Saudi-led forces say they destroyed two missile launchers in Sanaa on Oct 26 (#1349).
pending: Whether the US joins the Saudi strikes (#1341)
Whether the Houthis carry out their warning against US interests (#1342)
